rule: ENTER BETA only if every entry criterion is met. Failing quality or budget gates do NOT block Beta (they become the measured deficits that drive Beta issues); missing evidence, unpromoted architecture, or unmeasured populations DO block it, because architecture/product viability is then unproven. The measured-deficit backlog is generated whenever a candidate is measured; it is a candidate Beta backlog and does not by itself mean Beta was entered.
